title: Dative roles in a paragraph
subtitle: Let the clause, not a label, determine the relationship.
overview: Several datives can occur in one paragraph with different relationships: recipient, means, sphere, or reference.
For each, write a short relational gloss (to whom, by what, in what respect) before producing polished English.

items.grc: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν.
items.en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father.
In the world you have affliction.
